name: Sidar Kondo of Jamuraa
oracle_text:
Flanking (Whenever a creature without flanking blocks this creature, the blocking creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.)
Creatures your opponents control without flying or reach can't block creatures with power 2 or less.
Partner (You can have two commanders if both have partner.)
blocked_sentences: Flanking (Whenever a creature without flanking blocks this creature, the blocking creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.)

needs.what: the flanking keyword (702.25): a creature that has it, when blocked by a creature WITHOUT flanking, gives that blocker -1/-1 until end of turn; it must be a keyword the engine knows so that 'without flanking' can be tested on the blocker and so that multiple instances trigger separately
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `flanking` is not in the packet's `keywords`, so neither the card can carry it nor a filter can ask `not_keywords: ["flanking"]` of the blocker. A hand-written `becomes_blocked` trigger with a `pump` of -1/-1 on the blocker could approximate the effect, but it cannot express the 'without flanking' exemption (no flanking keyword to read, and `trigger_filter_keys` has no `not_keywords`), and other cards granting or reading flanking would not see it
